messages.subject: uploaded file path
parts:
Hi all,

I would like to detect the file path of an uploaded file using shiny, something similar to the native file.choose().
So far I get a temp folder created by shiny, and instead I would like the actual path selected by the user when using the file input button.

Thanks very much in advance,
Adrian

messages.author: 53dbab5845ace6b6
messages.subject: Re: uploaded file path
parts:
Apparently, this is impossible.
The fileUpload() function in Shiny is a sort of a Download button in any web browser, which treats the actual file system as a "server".
Due to security issues, it is forbidden for web browsers to have access to the server's file system... therefore getting the actual file path is not possible.

I hope this helps anyone,
Adrian
